objective.text: The primary goal of the FLEX-2 flight experiments is to extend the results of FLEX-1 to fuels and environmental conditions that mimic real combustor conditions.
objective.quote: The primary goal of the FLEX-2 flight experiments is to extend the results of FLEX-1 to fuels and environmental conditions that mimic real combustor conditions

fuel.text: The FLEX-2 experiments used bi-component mixtures.
fuel.quote: The present FLEX-2 experiments using bi-component mixtures.

sample_geometry.text: The fuel was dispensed as a droplet onto the support fiber or freely deployed.
sample_geometry.quote: dispensing of a predetermined amount of fuel (based on the target droplet size) onto the support fiber for those tests in which the droplet is not freely deployed.

oxygen.text: The oxygen concentration was varied between 0.1 to 0.4 mole fraction.
oxygen.quote: O2 concentration between 0.1 to 0.4 mole fraction

source.ref: Objectives, Approach, Hypothesis, Research Impacts/Earth Benefits

pressure.text: The pressure was varied between 0.5 atm to 3.0 atm.
pressure.quote: varied in pressure between 0.5 atm to 3.0 atm

variables.text: The independently varied experimental parameters included fuel type, ambient gas composition, ambient pressure, droplet initial diameter, droplet translation velocity, and droplet spacing.
variables.quote: The independently varied experimental parameters during FLEX-2 experiments were 1) Fuel type 2) Ambient gas composition 3) Ambient Pressure 4) Droplet initial diameter 5) Droplet translation velocity (and acceleration) 6) Droplet spacing and initial size in a binary linear array.

measurements.text: Combustion and flame evolution were monitored and tracked using high speed photography, and pressure and temperature data were recorded.
measurements.quote: Monitor combustions and track flame evolution using high speed photography

source.ref: Objectives, Approach, Hypothesis, Research Impacts/Earth Benefits

earth_benefits.text: Insights gained from these studies can lead to more efficient and cleaner combustion technologies which are crucial for reducing pollution and greenhouse gas emissions.
earth_benefits.quote: Insights gained from these studies can lead to more efficient and cleaner combustion technologies which are crucial for reducing pollution and greenhouse gas emissions.
